'''Plum''' (Japanese: '''プラム''' ''Plum'') is an exorcist-in-training from the manga series [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. She only appears in the chapter ''[[PPP59|The Exorcist Nurse!!]]'', where she banishes characters' dark [[wp:Qi|Aura]] with her holy cross. She travels with her senior, {{MPJ|Chansey}}, to build her exorcism skills.

She has a crush on [[Peanut]], and moves in next-door to him after uncovering and failing to banish his overbearing dark Aura.

==Trivia==
* Plum's birthday being on March 14 is a reference to {{wp|White Day}}, which occurs on March 14, while her crush's birthday falls on {{wp|Valentine's Day}}, which occurs on February 14.
